usedFor: Webinar events in Livestorm, like “Session Started”, run a command on your computers through “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd.

bestTemplate.name: “Registrant Attended” in Livestorm, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: Fires once a session ends with the registrant counted present, and the action runs a command on your computers.

watchOut: “Registrant Attended” and “Registrant Didn't Attend” both fire after a session, so give each its own command.
